text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Would you be interested in a hot spring trip!?"
...Ryoka Tsurugi's partner, Sonon Elfie, suddenly called out of the blue with that.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Congraaaaatulaaaations!!
We have a winner for the grand prize, the "Hot Springs Vacation Voucher"~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I actually won it in a lottery, but try as I might,
I simply couldn't make my schedule fit!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"It looked like Tsurugi-san was thinking of giving it to someone else,
but... I really want her to get some rest and recharge!
Tsurugi-san deserves it!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Ryoka-san will feel completely relaxed if it's with you, Trainer!!
What do you say?!"
...Sonon Elfie's heartfelt care is clear as day. I want to help her out here.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, Trainer!
.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for joining me today
despite your busy schedule.
choice_data_list: No, no, not at all! If you're okay with me, anytime!
No, no, not at all! If you're okay with me, anytime!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it was a hot spring inn I was quite interested in.
I felt a little reluctant to part with it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, this is shaping up to be a wonderful trip.
――Well then, shall we get going?

And so, Ryoka Tsurugi and I arrived at the hot spring inn.
The scent of sulfur hung in the air as the bamboo water fountain clacked in the distance...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It has such a lovely atmosphere, just as I'd hoped.
choice_data_list: Indeed, it really helps you unwind.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Once we drop our luggage in the room,
would you like to take a walk around the area?
It's quite famous for its rich nature, after all.
So, I came to enjoy a peaceful walk in the woods, but—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The babbling of the brook is so soothing.
The air is wonderfully clean, too...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry to speak to you out of the blue.
Um, I just wondered if something was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
On the way here, she stopped several times to check her footing
and look all around her, so...

Feeling self-conscious that my secret was out, I confessed.
The truth was, ever since we entered the mountain, this perfectly
rugged terrain had caught my eye—
choice_data_list: I thought it might be useful for training...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that <chrname>'s...?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
A sudden stroke of inspiration, was it?
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry! You came here to rest today...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, please don't apologize.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Right...
Then let's call it a day on the mountain hike
and go check out the town next, shall we?

I brace myself to focus purely on the trip this time around.
...And yet――
choice_data_list: Ms. Tsurugi! Those steamed buns…… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Barker
text_block_list.text: Step right up, take a look! Compare the taste of our local eggs, boiled to onsen perfection! We've got a fun event going on right now~!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
All this bustle... the strong local flavor really is charming.
Oh, right, Elfie's next guest eventâ

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes!?
...From then on, wherever they went, Ryoka Tsurugi thought of Sonon Elfie, and Sonon Elfie thought of <chrname>――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
――Fufufu, honestly.
What are we going to do with the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I used to be quite good at switching between on and off modes... but lately, it's been difficult.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be because it doesn't feel like a burden at all?

With both of us surely thinking of our respective partners,
Ryoka Tsurugi and I nod to one another.

Before I realize it, I'm thinking about her.
About wanting to support and guide her.
...The desire to make her dream come true together.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...We'll soak in the hot springs and have dinner.
And after that, let's get a good night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: We'll build up plenty of stamina. And once we get back—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: So that I can work even harder right alongside them.

Then, as if declaring the same vow,
I looked up at the starry sky alongside Ryoka Tsurugi.
